package resp

import (
	"net/url"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"example.com/dep"
)

type page struct{ Path string }

type shadowClient struct{}

// TestShadowed names local bindings after imports; neither package is needed.
func TestShadowed(t *testing.T) {
	url := page{Path: Response()}
	if !strings.Contains(url.Path, `"id"`) {
		t.Error("missing field id")
	}
	func(dep page) {
		if dep.Path == "" {
			t.Error("empty path")
		}
	}(url)
}

// TestRebinds reads the import before a local takes its name.
func TestRebinds(t *testing.T) {
	url, err := url.Parse("http://example.com/p")
	if err != nil || url.Path != "/p" {
		t.Error("parse")
	}
}

// TestShadowedMethod reaches a test-side method through a shadowing local.
func TestShadowedMethod(t *testing.T) {
	var url shadowClient
	url.reached()
}

func (shadowClient) reached() {}

func TestUntracked(t *testing.T) {
	_, _ = url.Parse(dep.Base)
}
